notes.notes: We fixed the achievements issues that some people were experiencing. Please let us know if you still have any issues. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Milo and the Magpies Release & 40% OFF Rusty Lake!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/c69de201142c340b15a314b8bb90cefe70f4c083.png

We’re so proud of Johan Scherft, who made the amazing background painting of Rusty Lake: Roots and more! After 2 years of hard work he just released his first point-and-click adventure game: Milo and the Magpies 😻

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407420/Milo_and_the_Magpies/

Can you guide Milo back home? 🐈 

[previewyoutube=9BR1pPYA_Zs;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re more than honored to be part of his journey through our publishing program Second Maze and we hope you will support him as well 🙏

To celebrate Johan's first ever release, we also launched a 40% OFF sale on all our premium games!

notes.title: Rusty Lake Hotel is now FREE [Limited Time] + Major Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=7CLG7ii37aI;full][/previewyoutube]

Rusty Lake Hotel is FREE for a limited time to celebrate our 6-year anniversary!! 🎊 Get it now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/435120/Rusty_Lake_Hotel/ (also free on other platfroms)

We also made some much requested updates to Rusty Lake Hotel:

💬 18 new translations
💥 Steam achievements and Steam Cloud Save
🖥️ Added a fullscreen function
▶️ And a way to replay each room!

The game remains free till the 1st of May! Please enjoy your free stay! 🦐
Oh and all our premium games are on 50% sale too: developer page  🖤

Greetings from The Lake!

notes.title: Cube Escape Collection - Release date + Trailer
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/7840c5679b78faccf1deb65fa216558498b198a9.jpg

Finally! The Cube Escape Collection will be released on October 14th on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R6RUyC-w9Lk

Follow the path of Dale, Laura and other Rusty lake characters like Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl in this classic point-and-click adventure anthology! The nine Cube Escape games are updated (achievements / hints / translations), preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

Thanks for your support 🖤

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection

Art by Sevenix!
